title: Mac app load panel: CPU, memory and battery shown beside the Claude session and weekly limits, as an add-on that can be switched off

requirements.text: Beside the Claude session and weekly limit bars, the Mac app shows current CPU load, memory pressure and battery level and drain, updating live
requirements.check: eye: TJ relaunches and sees the three readings change under load

requirements.text: A setting switches the load panel off, and when off nothing is sampled
requirements.check: manual: turn it off; the panel is gone and no sampler process or timer runs

requirements.text: Each reading shows a short recent history so pressure over time is visible
requirements.check: eye: TJ sees a trend line for each reading

requirements.text: Sampling costs under 1% CPU on its own
requirements.check: manual: Activity Monitor shows the app's CPU with the panel on vs off differing by under 1%

text: LoadSampler (GenlockCore/SystemLoad.swift, Codable LoadReading) + LoadMonitor/LoadMeter (GenlockApp/LoadPanel.swift) beside UsageMeter; Session menu Show/Hide System Load. 163 swift tests pass. Building release + background relaunch.

evidence: swift test SystemLoadCostTests: LoadSampler.sample() = 0.13-0.20 ms CPU per reading; at one reading per 5 s that is 0.003-0.004% of one core. Off: LoadMonitor.stop() invalidates the timer and drops the sampler.

text: Panel live in relaunched app (pid 8059). Found + fixed old bug: removeForgottenChannels (AppModel) deleted voice/usage.json every launch; 5s ticker then blanked the meter. Usage meter still absent: server poll has written no usage.json in 15+ min, cause unverified (token read was denied to me). Left: TJ eyes reqs 1-3.

Usage meter gone because server poll answers HTTP 429 (usage-poll.txt, 13:42Z) and launch cleanup had deleted usage.json (fixed). Added usage-poll.txt note + 'limits –' placeholder (built, not yet relaunched). Waiting for 10-min backoff to see if next poll returns 200.

Limits meter: fetch code unchanged since 63c3d25 (diff vs HEAD = only logging + cleanup fix). Every poll since relaunch = HTTP 429 (13:42Z, 13:53Z). Built (not running) UsagePoller honoring Retry-After + persisting quiet-until + logging 429 body; my background relaunch was blocked by the rm safety check, so TJ's 'Restart to update' installs it.
TJ relaunched 14:1xZ: limits meter shows. usage.json (written 14:05Z) survived the relaunch, confirming the cleanup fix. Load panel reqs 1-3 still need TJ's eye check.

TJ loves the panel; asked to split the stacked cpu/mem/bat rows. Now three side-by-side chips (label, 34x14 sparkline, value). Built; waits on TJ's Restart to update (my relaunch path is blocked by the rm check).

All 4 reqs built; req 4 proved. Split into 3 side-by-side chips per TJ ('3 panels on top of each other looks really odd'), built, awaiting TJ's Restart to update + eye check of reqs 1-3, then commit by path (LoadPanel.swift, SystemLoad.swift, SystemLoadTests.swift, AppModel/AppUpdater/UsagePoller/DashboardView/SessionsView/GenlockApp.swift hunks are shared with other sessions' edits).

evidence: TJ eyed the relaunched app, 13 Nov: 'yep i like the split out panels' (cpu/mem/bat chips beside the limits meter, live values); earlier 'loves the panel'
Each chip carries a 34x14 sparkline of the last 10 min (LoadMonitor.kept=120 x 5s); TJ approved the split chips with their trend lines: 'yep i like the split out panels'

text: TJ: header overloaded, buttons wrapping (screenshot 1.08pm). Fixed: GlassButtonStyle .lineLimit(1).fixedSize(); LoadMeter in ViewThatFits (chips+trends -> chips only -> nothing) at layoutPriority -1, header Spacers at -2. Built, awaiting Restart to update + eye check.

evidence: re-eyed after header fix: TJ 'i see it ok great. and dashboar dis better'

text: TJ eyed header fix: 'i see it ok great. and dashboar dis better'. Left: req 2 (Hide System Load -> load.json removed, no timer) unchecked live: needs a menu click (osascript lacks assistive access). Uncommitted: LoadPanel.swift, SystemLoad.swift, LoadAlerts.swift, tests, lib/load.mjs, hunks in AppModel/Theme/DashboardView/SessionsView/GenlockApp/Notifier.swift, bin/genlock.mjs (shared with other sessions: commit by path).

evidence: TJ accepted without the live menu click ('yes those are fine'). Code: LoadMonitor.stop() invalidates the timer, drops the sampler and removes load.json; not observed live (no assistive access to click the menu).

answers.observed: Live app: genlock load printed CPU 78%/12 cores, mem 67%, battery 57% charging 3.6W from voice/load.json written 2s earlier; TJ eyed chips and the header fix
answers.cause: Header wrapping was caused by GlassButtonStyle labels compressing in a crowded HStack; fixed with fixedSize + ViewThatFits at layoutPriority -1, TJ confirmed 'i see it ok great'
answers.absence: Panel-off sampling stop never observed live: no assistive access to click the menu; waived on TJ's word
answers.assumption: Mine: chips collapse (trends, then chips) rather than buttons shrinking; TJ approved the result
answers.falsify: Hide System Load leaves load.json updating, or a narrow window still wraps a button
